//: Curated catalogue of the studio-mcp-catalog (D49, owner review D50). contributes.mcpServers[] is the live list, seeded by AionCore as the built-in catalogue (crates/aionui-mcp/catalogue/). market.category/vendor/official/optional/summary/billing drive the library browse; read_tools pins the proxy read allowlist (enforcement proxy, GAPS G3); a plain env key with a pattern is a launch parameter (GAPS G1). No secret values: only env keys of kind secret.
name: studio-mcp-catalog

mcpServers.name: GitHub
mcpServers.description: GitHub official remote MCP with a fine-grained PAT. Read tier forces X-MCP-Readonly; lockdown hides untrusted public content.

GITHUB_PAT.description: GitHub fine-grained PAT (read tier: read-only repository permissions)

GITHUB_MCP_LOCKDOWN.description: Lockdown mode (hide public content from non-pushers)

market.summary: Repos, issues, pull requests and CI

mcpServers.name: Context7
mcpServers.description: Up-to-date library and framework docs (Upstash, official). Read-only; one of the two global ids (R2).

CONTEXT7_API_KEY.description: Context7 API key (optional: without it, lower rate limits)

market.summary: Up-to-date library and framework docs

mcpServers.name: DeepWiki
mcpServers.description: Ask questions about any public GitHub repo (Cognition, official, free, no auth).

market.summary: Ask questions about any public GitHub repo

mcpServers.name: Supabase
mcpServers.description: Supabase official remote MCP, pinned per instance to one project (project_ref, G1). Write tier: migrations, execute_sql, functions, branching. Read tier forces read_only=true (queries run as a read-only Postgres user). The PAT is account-wide, so the project_ref is required before an instance can be active.

SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF.description: Project ref of the one Supabase project this instance may reach (20 lowercase letters, from the dashboard URL)

SUPABASE_READ_ONLY.description: Server read-only switch (set by the tier)

market.summary: Database, SQL and migrations of one Supabase project

mcpServers.name: Sentry
mcpServers.description: Sentry official MCP (getsentry/toolkit). Read tier forces MCP_SKILLS=inspect; pair with a read-scoped token.

SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN.description: Sentry user auth token (read tier: org:read, project:read, event:read)

market.summary: Errors, issues and performance monitoring

mcpServers.name: Cloudflare API
mcpServers.description: Cloudflare official code-mode MCP (search/execute over the whole API). Read-only only through a read-only API token.

CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN.description: Cloudflare API token (read tier: read-only permissions; no IP filter)

market.summary: DNS, WAF, Workers and the whole Cloudflare API

mcpServers.name: Chrome DevTools
mcpServers.description: Chrome DevTools official MCP: Lighthouse, performance traces, console/network. Headless, isolated profile, no usage stats, no CrUX lookups.

market.summary: Lighthouse audits, performance traces, console and network

mcpServers.name: Paddle (live)
mcpServers.description: Paddle official hosted MCP, live environment. Read tier = an API key with read permissions only (no server switch).

PADDLE_API_KEY.description: Paddle live API key (read tier: read permissions only)

market.summary: Paddle live: customers, subscriptions, transactions

mcpServers.name: Paddle (sandbox)
mcpServers.description: Paddle official hosted MCP, sandbox environment (key starts pdl_sdbx_).

market.summary: Paddle sandbox for tests

mcpServers.name: Stripe
mcpServers.description: Stripe official hosted MCP with an Agent-tagged restricted key. From 2026-11-30 the hosted server accepts only Agent keys: older rk_live_ restricted keys stop working. Test-mode key for staging, live key for production.

STRIPE_AGENT_KEY.description: Stripe Agent-tagged restricted key. From 2026-11-30 only Agent keys work (older restricted keys are refused); read tier: read permissions only

market.summary: Stripe payments, customers and subscriptions

mcpServers.name: PostHog
mcpServers.description: PostHog official MCP. Read tier forces the x-posthog-read-only header (server removes create/update/delete tools); one instance per project.

market.summary: Product analytics, flags, experiments, heatmaps and replays

mcpServers.name: Google Analytics 4
mcpServers.description: GA4 official MCP (googleanalytics). Read-only (analytics.readonly); write tools stay off.

GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS.description: Path to a 0600 service-account JSON (GAPS G5)

market.summary: Google Analytics 4 reports (Google Ads projects only)

mcpServers.name: Google Search Console
mcpServers.description: Community mcp-search-console (AminForou/mcp-gsc; no official server). Read tier forces GSC_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE=false (webmasters.readonly scope).

GSC_CREDENTIALS_PATH.description: Path to a 0600 service-account JSON (GAPS G5)

GSC_SKIP_OAUTH.description: Use the service account, no browser OAuth

market.summary: Search Console queries, pages and indexing

mcpServers.name: Google Ads Keyword Planner
mcpServers.description: Community keyword-planner-mcp (GroMarketing, MIT, 0.1.1 of 2026-10-05, low adoption): keyword ideas, search volumes and location lookup. Read-only tools. Google sunset developer tokens on 2026-09-09; the README still asks for one.

GOOGLE_ADS_REFRESH_TOKEN.description: OAuth refresh token with the adwords scope

GOOGLE_ADS_DEVELOPER_TOKEN.description: Developer token (sunset by Google on 2026-09-09; set only if the server still asks for it)

market.summary: Keyword ideas and search volumes from Google Ads

mcpServers.name: Google Ads
mcpServers.description: Google Ads official MCP. Read tier points GOOGLE_ADS_MCP_TOOLS_CONFIG at a config with labels/assets disabled (GAPS G5).

GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS.description: Path to a 0600 ADC/service-account JSON with the adwords scope (GAPS G5)

market.summary: Google Ads reporting (GAQL) and assets

mcpServers.name: Meta Ads
mcpServers.description: Meta official Ads MCP (open beta). Read tier = system-user token with ads_mcp_management + ads_read only (unverified that this hides write tools).

market.summary: Meta (Facebook/Instagram) ads insights and management

mcpServers.name: Resend
mcpServers.description: Resend official MCP (send, broadcasts, contacts, domains). No server read switch: read tier = pinned proxy allowlist (G3). Attachments pinned to an empty dir.

SENDER_EMAIL_ADDRESS.description: Default From address on a verified domain

MCP_ALLOWED_FILE_DIRS.description: Directories attachments may be read from

market.summary: Transactional and product email

mcpServers.name: Brevo
mcpServers.description: Brevo official hosted MCP (campaigns, contacts, CRM, templates; all modules). No read-only switch: read tier = proxy allowlist.

BREVO_API_KEY.description: Brevo API key created with the MCP option

market.summary: Email campaigns, contacts and CRM

mcpServers.name: Airtable
mcpServers.description: Airtable official hosted MCP. Read tier = PAT with data.records:read, schema.bases:read, data.recordComments:read, workspacesAndBases:read only, granted per base.

AIRTABLE_PAT.description: Airtable personal access token (scoped to the project's bases)

market.summary: Airtable bases, tables and records

mcpServers.name: Google Workspace
mcpServers.description: Community google_workspace_mcp (Sheets, Drive, Docs; Gmail/Calendar opt-in). Read tier forces WORKSPACE_MCP_READ_ONLY=true. First OAuth consent needs a browser (GAPS G6).

USER_GOOGLE_EMAIL.description: Google account the instance acts as

market.summary: Sheets, Drive and Docs (Gmail/Calendar opt-in)

mcpServers.name: Exa
mcpServers.description: Exa official web search MCP. ENABLED_TOOLS forced to search/fetch/advanced search (agent_run excluded: up to $1 per run).

market.summary: Web search and page fetch for every CLI

mcpServers.name: Brave Search
mcpServers.description: Brave official Search MCP: web, news, image, video, local and LLM-context search. Every call is a billed Brave API request; BRAVE_MCP_ENABLED_TOOLS narrows the tool set (space-separated).

market.summary: Web, news, image and local search

mcpServers.name: Perplexity
mcpServers.description: Perplexity official remote MCP (recommended by Perplexity): search, ask, reason and deep research with citations. All tools are billed; perplexity_research is the costliest.

market.summary: Answers and deep research with citations

mcpServers.name: Firecrawl
mcpServers.description: Firecrawl official MCP: scrape, search, map, crawl. Read tier = pinned proxy allowlist (map, search, status, monitors read); scrape/crawl/interact count as write (browser actions).

market.summary: Scrape, crawl and map websites

mcpServers.name: Reddit (read-only)
mcpServers.description: reddit-mcp-buddy (community): read-only Reddit browsing/search, anonymous access. Optional.

market.summary: Read-only Reddit browsing and search

mcpServers.name: MiniMax media
mcpServers.description: MiniMax official MCP: image, video, speech, music generation. Spends credits (cap by balance); no owned data changed.

market.summary: Image, video, speech and music generation
